title: Activation Patching to Localize a Hidden Goal in a Model Organism

original_idea.body:
# Activation Patching to Localize a Hidden Goal in a Model Organism

**Problem:** A model pursuing a secret goal it never verbalizes is a core long-horizon threat; localization of the hidden-goal representation is under-studied with simple causal tools.

**Direction:** Use a public hidden-goal organism (or construct one via system-prompt injection) and apply activation patching between goal-pursuing and neutral runs to localize the goal; test whether it appears before the CoT.

**Why it matters:** Detecting CoT-bypassing hidden goals is a core deceptive-alignment concern. Feasible in 30h.

**Relevant context:** arXiv 2404.14082; model-organism studies; TransformerLens.
